column5: Can the AI take actions on its own?
column6: For example send email, change records or call an API.

column5: Does a person approve high-impact actions?
column15: No person approves high-impact agent actions.
column16: Add a human approval step before the agent changes data.

column5: How many people hold admin rights to the AI console?
column15: Too many people hold admin rights.
column16: Reduce admin rights to a small named group.
